text: Underway here, DeepSeek Rovers in deep blue facing the all-white of Real Machina.
Straight away, Zidroid touches the ball right through on goal into empty space! A glorious opening inside the first ten seconds.
CR-7000 topples over on the carpet.
Rovers tangle, and Signal goes down.
Now Abyss tumbles over as well.
Abyss scrambles up to challenge Zidroid, sending the Real Machina forward clattering onto the deck. Both sides struggling to stay vertical.
Zidroid responds, flattening Signal this time.
Whistling past the post! Just a coat of paint away from the opener.
Signal steps in firmly on the right channel, cleanly taking Zidroid off their feet. Real Machina's forward will need a few seconds to reset and rise.
Zidroid calls out, demanding help to shift the ball away from the boards.
Rovers have set up camp here in the attacking third, keeping Real Machina pinned against their own wall. The pressure is mounting on the founding club.
Abyss signals control near the wall.
Zidroid breaks clear into open space!
Driving along the right touchline with purpose, Zidroid pushes the magenta ball into midfield.
The corner panel activates with a loud clack, spitting the ball back into the mixer.
Zidroid bundles it home from point-blank range! Real Machina break the deadlock! A poacher's finish right at the mouth of the goal, and the white shirts lead one-nil!
Abyss calls to work it clear.
And CR-7000 tucks it away from point-blank! Two quick goals for Real Machina, doubling their advantage in the blink of an eye.
Abyss comes clattering in with a heavy challenge in midfield, sending Zidroid sprawling across the deck. Real Machina won't mind too much with this two-goal cushion.

A quiet spell as Signal retrieves the ball. Real Machina are a curious outfit—the frozen founding club, built without a gaffer, never altered between matches, yet they have taken this first half by the throat.
Zidroid bursts clean through the middle once again.
Zidroid charges straight towards goal.
Zidroid finishes with ruthless composure! That is three for Real Machina, who are running riot before the break.
Real Machina are relentless as Zidroid pushes the ball straight back into the final third.
Pounded into the bevelled corner, and the push-panel fires it out.
Flashed wide of the target.
Zidroid bundles in another right at the goal mouth! A first-half hat-trick for the number two, and DeepSeek Rovers are being completely dismantled here. Four-nil.
Abyss shouts to peel the ball off the perimeter wall.
To compound DeepSeek's misery, Signal simply loses footing on the touchline and hits the deck. They will have to wait for the gyros to correct themselves.
There sounds the hooter for half time. A thoroughly one-sided affair so far, with Real Machina cruising at four goals to nil. Rovers need a complete reboot before the second period.
CR-7000 drives down the middle.
A snap effort from CR-7000 drifts a metre wide. Real Machina picking up right where they left off.
Zidroid alerts the teammate that the ball is coming off the boards.
Zidroid advances on the right.
DeepSeek are hemmed in again.
Skimming just wide of the near post.
Signal finds a rare lane clean through on goal.
Signal takes an age bringing it forward out of their own third, nudging the ball along the right channel. A bit too deliberate when chasing a four-goal deficit.
Punished immediately! CR-7000 sweeps it into the net from close range to make it five. It is becoming an absolute rout for the all-white shirts.
Signal calls to extract the ball.
And CR-7000 pounces again! Six-nil now to Real Machina, tapping it in at point-blank range without a whisper of resistance.
Abyss clatters into CR-7000 in the centre circle, leaving the Real Machina forward flat on the floor.
Just wide of the upright.
CR-7000 goes down entirely unassisted near the right touchline. The actuators just seem to give way, but with a six-goal lead, they can take their time standing back up.
Signal probes up the left channel.
Rovers sustained pressure comes to nothing.
CR-7000 breaks away clean through.
Abyss is calling out to shift the ball out from the wall.
DeepSeek named an unchanged squad after their win earlier today, but they look entirely drained. CR-7000 can just casually roll the ball five metres up the flank.
Abyss gives a shout to work the ball loose from the boards on the right channel. Time is rapidly slipping away from Rovers.
Real Machina pin them deep.
Signal collapses again without a challenge. A miserable outing for the defender.
Zidroid rolls it across the line for number seven. It has been target practice for Real Machina, and Zidroid bags their fourth of the match. Seven-nil.
The powered ram in the corner fires the ball sharply back out into the final third.
Signal puts in a late reducer, knocking Zidroid over, but it is far too little, far too late.
Shaved the post. Half a metre wide, but Real Machina are enjoying every second of these final exchanges.
And there is the eighth! CR-7000 seals a four-goal haul of their own with seconds to spare. Eight-nil to Real Machina.
Full time, nil-eight to Real Machina. Singularity United meet GLM Friday: 20:00 UK, 21:00 Europe, 15:00 US East.
